# switch statement rules

switch (value) {
  case 0, 1 -> consume();
  case 2 -> throw new IllegalArgumentException();
  default -> {}
}

==>

Program(
  SwitchStatement(
    switch,
    ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier),
    SwitchBlock(
      SwitchRule(
        SwitchLabel(case, IntegerLiteral, IntegerLiteral),
        ExpressionStatement(
          MethodInvocation(MethodName(Identifier), ArgumentList))),
      SwitchRule(
        SwitchLabel(case, IntegerLiteral),
        ThrowStatement(
          throw,
          ObjectCreationExpression(
            new,
            TypeName,
            ArgumentList))),
      SwitchRule(
        SwitchLabel(default),
        Block))))

# multiple constants in a traditional switch label

switch (value) {
  case 0, 1:
    break;
  default:
    break;
}

==>

Program(
  SwitchStatement(
    switch,
    ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier),
    SwitchBlock(
      SwitchLabel(case, IntegerLiteral, IntegerLiteral),
      BreakStatement(break),
      SwitchLabel(default),
      BreakStatement(break))))
